publications.name: Firm Financial Performance and Organizational Culture under Environmental Volatility
publications.summary: Co-authored with Dean of Haas and scholars from Stanford, Columbia, and UMD. Ran OLS/SEM on 1,113 firms using NLP-scored culture variables from 1.82M Glassdoor reviews. Identified results-oriented culture as strongest predictor of financial performance (β=0.022, Tobin's Q R²=0.63).

publications.name: Policy Shocks: Stock Market Response of Indonesia's Nickel Export Ban
publications.summary: 2-stage event study on 15 firms against JCI Index. Producer equities underperformed control by 55pp (p<0.01). Consumer impact negligible and statistically insignificant. Cross-sectional OLS on CAR with adj. R²=0.56.

projects.summary: Ridge regression (alpha=1.0) on 9.4M observations with 20 features to predict 90-day equity returns. Capped-proportional allocation across top 15 stocks (10% cap). Trained 2015-2020, tested 2021-2025. Outputs Sharpe ratio and max drawdown analytics.
